body: Forward test of the base rate method (NOT a recommendation; not buy/sell). Probability 0.55 (naive base rate 0.70) that: Infosys raises the midpoint of its FY27 constant-currency revenue guidance above 1.5% at Q3 FY27 results. Evidence: Q2 FY27 (Oct-2026): FY27 cc guidance cut from 1.5–3% to 1–2%; op-margin guide 20–22% kept (Q2 ~21%). Q2 cc growth +1.5% YoY, +1.2% QoQ; H1 +1.9% cc. Mgmt cites soft volumes, pricing pressure/AI deflation, weak Retail/Hi-Tech, rate rises; large deals TCV $8.8 bn. Infosys history at Q3: midpoint raised in FY23, FY25 and FY26, unchanged (narrowed) in FY24. Reasoning: H1 at 1.9% means the 1–2% band already embeds a weak H2; Q3 has furloughs, and they just cut. A narrow-upward revision (e.g., 1.5–2%) is plausible but so is a hold. Below the historical base because this year's direction of revision was down. Resolution: YES if the FY27 cc revenue guidance announced with Q3 FY27 results has a midpoint strictly greater than 1.5% (e.g., 1.5–2.0% or 1.75–2.25%). Hold at 1–2% or any cut = NO. Source: Infosys Q3 FY27 press release / fact sheet (infosys.com, NSE). Resolve by 2027-01-31; score with Brier vs base rate.
